summary: Iter108 — Merchant Wallet page (Expo web mobile viewport) + backend APIs tested end-to-end. Backend 8/8 pytest passed (overview shape/config/finance, transactions pagination+direction+q, withdrawals list, withdraw create+persistence, min-amount reject, insufficient-balance reject). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: onboard→demo-merchant→tab-wallet loads Wallet & Withdraw with hero ₹35,744.18 = overview.available_balance, KYC blocker absent (finance.eligible=true), KPIs render, tabs switch, tx search 'Adjustment' filters to 6 rows, direction credit filter works, page-size 25 shows 25 rows, tx drawer shows Reference ID/Balance after and closes, full 5-step withdraw flow (500) submits successfully → WD-608779 → auto-switches to Withdrawals tab → wd row with Pending badge → wd drawer shows Withdrawal ID/Requested/Method BANK/HDFC Bank/••••7890/Processing fee/Net payable/Timeline (Request submitted + Under review). Amount-50 shows 'Minimum ₹100' error and disables Continue. Back buttons (2/3/4) navigate to previous step. Hero Pending & kpi-processing update to ₹500 after withdrawal.

issues: Tabs row (Overview/Transactions/Withdrawals) sits just at/under the bottom nav on initial render — must scroll wallet-module ScrollView to interact. Not blocking (expected mobile behavior) but note that tab targets are ~5–10px above bottom nav; consider adding bottom padding to wallet-module so tabs are naturally above bottom nav on first load.

critical_code_review_comments: services/merchant_wallet_service.py:97-99 enforces single pending withdrawal per merchant. This is correct product behavior but is implicit; consider surfacing this constraint to the mobile UI (disable withdraw-btn or show a banner when a pending withdrawal exists) so users don't hit a 400 at submit-time after completing 4 steps of the flow.

wallet.tsx: after successful withdraw the flow auto-navigates to Withdrawals tab correctly; view-all-tx / view-all-wd buttons on Overview weren't reachable in one scroll pass — verify they render below Recent lists with visible bottom padding above the fixed bottom nav.
